name: DCA Ghirardelli Soda Fountain Non-Dairy Hot Fudge Sundae (Coconut Vanilla & Non-Dairy Fudge)
brandOrRestaurant: Ghirardelli Soda Fountain & Chocolate Shop (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: dairy free hot fudge sundae dca
whyItWorks: Ghirardelli in DCA makes a dedicated Non-Dairy Hot Fudge Sundae using creamy coconut-milk vanilla "ice cream," dairy-free dark chocolate hot fudge, and almond-milk whipped topping—zero lactose! Just remember to ask for NO diced almonds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Non-Dairy Hot Fudge Sundae** and specifically request **"No Diced Almonds"** on top; share the generous cup to keep sugar reasonable.
watchOuts: Default sundae comes topped with chopped almonds—always ask for "no almonds" so it stays nut-free and low-residue
